snippet.title: Jamboy, a Jelly-cious Hero | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Jamboy is a flavour-packed platformer inspired by classics, like Rayman & Earthworm Jim. This juicy adventure is getting ready for your tastebuds, this September 25th! Open wide, cause it's coming to Steam and Switch! 

STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2403600/Jamboy_a_Jellycious_Hero/

NINTENDO E SHOP:
https://www.nintendo.com/es-es/Juegos/Programas-descargables-Nintendo-Switch/Jamboy-a-Jelly-cious-Hero-2890842.html
